# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_WIDTH_EXPANSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
When the EMA ribbon (9,12,15,20,26,35,50,60) contracts to a narrow width indicating low volatility and then expands sharply, the subsequent breakout tends to persist, providing a directional edge. This volatility expansion breakout pattern captures momentum after consolidation phases, which is not currently modeled in the registry using EMA ribbon width as a proxy.

## Mechanism
Compute ribbon width as (highest EMA - lowest EMA) of the 8-EMA ribbon on each bar. If ribbon width is below its 20-period low (lowest width in the last 20 bars) and then expands to >1.5 times that low width on a bar, and the close of that bar is above the highest EMA (long) or below the lowest EMA (short), enter at the close of that bar. Exit: stop at the opposite edge of the ribbon (below lowest EMA for long, above highest EMA for short); TP1 at 1.5R; runner using a premium-stop trail of 10% of ATR. Regime filters: VIX between 12-22, after 10:00 EST, avoid 12:00-13:30 EST lunch period.
